turnNotice: Your turn — challenge your left neighbour, or keep your card.
dealerNotice: You are the dealer — you swap with the stock, not a neighbour, and nobody can challenge you.
reenterExhausted: You may buy back in at most three times.

event.cuckoo: {{target}} held the Cuckoo — no swap, and the round ends here
event.hussar: {{target}} held the Hussar — the challenger {{actor}} goes out
event.pig: {{target}} held the Pig — the swap unwinds and {{target}} goes out
event.pass: {{actor}}'s challenge was passed to the next seat

deckNote: 42 cards of its own: 21 denominations twice over, a single suit. The five cards with an effect are colour-coded.
rulesNote: A Harlequin received in an exchange is the LOWEST card, not the highest.

tutorial.info: Round number, the pot and the stock are shown here.
tutorial.players: Each seat's chips and buy-backs. Everyone else's card stays face down until the showdown.
tutorial.card: Your single card. The lowest hand at the showdown goes out.
tutorial.actions: On your turn, exchange with your left neighbour or keep your card. As dealer you swap with the stock instead.
tutorial.resetButton: Reset the game at any time with this button.
